name: GET /api/sla/status - SLA compliance snapshot for the monitoring dashboard
description: Returns the SLA compliance picture leadership reads: how many leads are on_track, at_risk, breached and met inside the reporting window, the compliance rate, the average measured response time, and the leads currently needing attention ordered by urgency. A read, so it answers 200. Served from the local projection in ONE query rather than asking ProjexCloud sdk-sla per lead - a dashboard that fanned out one SDK read per row would be unusable at queue scale, so the sweep (POST /api/sla/evaluate) is what reconciles with sdk-sla and this endpoint reads the reconciled projection. clock_source therefore reports which clock last produced the stored verdicts. at_risk is computed live from sla_due_at at read time (at least 80 percent of the window elapsed with no first response) rather than being stored, so the snapshot is never stale between sweeps. compliance_rate is met / (met + breached) over CLOSED clocks only and is null when no clock has closed in the window - reporting 100 percent for an empty window would be a lie a manager acts on. average_response_seconds is measured from lead arrival, matching POST /api/leads/:id/first-response. window_minutes selects the reporting window by lead arrival time and defaults to 1440 (24 hours), clamped to 1..10080 (one week). owner_user_id narrows the snapshot to one representative so a manager can review an individual queue. Protected by the authenticate guard - the Authorization header is required on this GET. QA: depends on register (which creates the user passed as owner_user_id), login and a captured lead so the window is non-empty.

testCases.name: Read the SLA compliance snapshot for the last 24 hours
Reject a window_minutes that is not a number

errorCases.when: window_minutes is present but not an integer between 1 and 10080, or owner_user_id is present but not a well-formed UUID
the Authorization header is absent, or present without a Bearer token
the bearer token fails verification or has expired
